mods.name: Rewind - Time Machine
mods.description: A time machine mod that records world changes and allows rewinding the world state up to 30 seconds. Use /timeline rewind <seconds> to restore the past!

releases.notes:
### Usage

Start playing - the mod automatically records all changes
Something goes wrong (creeper explosion, accidental break, etc.)
Run /timeline rewind 10 to undo the last 10 seconds
The world is restored to its previous state

### Fully Supported

Block placement and destruction
Block state changes (doors, levers, redstone, etc.)
Block entity data (chests, furnaces, signs, etc.)
Entity spawning and despawning
Entity position and movement
Living entity health
